description: Reopen your lot to all visitors (default public mode). Prerequisite: caller must be the current lot's owner (VMTSOLotState.OwnerID == self). Effect: sets Lot_LotAdmitInfo.LotAdmitInfo_AdmitMode = 0 (admit-all) on the city DataService; fso_lots.admit_mode in the DB flips to 0. Cost: free. Idempotent. This verb uses mode=0 specifically; bypass values 1 (admit-list-only) and 2 (ban-list-only) are reached via admit-ban-lot list management.
call_signatures: cf $CF unlock-lot                                                                    # owner-only; flips AdmitMode to 0 (public)
common_mistakes: Assuming AdmitMode reset to 0 means 'friends-only' — 0 is fully public; use change-lot-permissions to narrow.
perception_hints: Your own persist_id (to avoid self-targeting): perception.avatar.persist_id
Target persist_id: perception.nearby_sims[].persist_id for Sims physically on the lot
Relationships for picking a roommate candidate: perception.relationships[]
refuse_conditions: caller is not lot owner → returns ok:false with 'caller is not lot owner (owner_id=..., me=...)'
target_persist_id is 0 or missing → returns ok:false with 'requires target_persist_id (> 0)'
target_persist_id == caller's own avatar_id → returns ok:false with 'cannot self-target' / 'cannot invite yourself'
